world.title: He Moved to the US on a Green Card and Wouldn't Do the Same on an H-1B
world.summary: Mohamed Zeeshan, a 32-year-old Indian national residing in Arlington, Virginia, shares his experience of moving to the US on a green card. He emphasizes that his decision was not driven by economic upliftment. The narrative, based on a conversation with him, highlights his perspective on immigration and the differences between obtaining a green card versus an H-1B visa.

world.title: Why US hospitals are outsourcing more work to India-and 2 stocks are riding the trend
world.summary: US hospitals are increasingly outsourcing administrative tasks to Indian companies, driven by a structural shift in healthcare spending. This trend presents new investment opportunities as hundreds of billions are allocated to manage healthcare transactions. Investors are advised to monitor this emerging theme, as it could significantly impact the financial landscape of both US and Indian healthcare sectors.

world.title: U.S. slaps 10% tariffs on goods imported from India over issue forced labour
world.summary: The U.S. has imposed 10% tariffs on goods imported from India and 16 other countries due to concerns over forced labor in production. This decision affects a total of 60 countries and was announced by U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. The tariffs aim to address human rights violations linked to labor practices in various industries.

business.title: Flipkart to launch food delivery over the coming weeks: Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy
business.summary: Flipkart, the Walmart-owned e-commerce platform, plans to launch a food delivery service in the coming weeks. This initiative will be in collaboration with the government-backed Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC). The announcement was made by Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, as the company aims to expand its offerings in the competitive food delivery market.

business.title: Quick Commerce just another category for Flipkart; see no merit in having 6-7 players: Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy
business.summary: Flipkart's Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy stated that its quick commerce service, Minutes, is merely "just another category" for the company. He expressed skepticism about the viability of having multiple players in the quick commerce space, which includes competitors like Amazon, Blinkit, Instamart, and Zepto, who are focusing on rapid delivery services.

business.title: Off: Dow Jones falls 500 points after crude rally; Alphabet, Tesla drag Nasdaq
business.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 500 points, reaching a low of over 650 points during the day. The S&P 500 decreased by 1.2%, while the Nasdaq Composite fell by 2.1%. Significant declines in tech stocks Tesla and Alphabet contributed to the Nasdaq's downturn, with Tesla shares falling 14.5% and Alphabet declining by 7%.

technology.title: Chaos Ransomware Turns Your Chrome and Edge Web Browser Into an Invisible Malware Command Channel
technology.summary: Chaos ransomware has developed a method to conceal its operations within Chrome and Edge browsers using the msaRAT remote-access tool. This technique allows attackers to stealthily execute commands and exfiltrate data while users browse the internet. By transforming these popular browsers into covert communication channels, the ransomware enhances its ability to operate undetected, posing significant security risks.

technology.title: T-Mobile and AT&T offer the Galaxy Z Fold8 for free, Z Fold8 Ultra for $200
technology.summary: T-Mobile and AT&T are offering the Galaxy Z Fold8 for free and the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra for $200. Additionally, promotions are available for the Galaxy Z Flip8 and the new Galaxy Watch9 and Watch Ultra2. The Galaxy Z Flip8 and Z Fold8 Ultra are priced $100 higher than previous models, with Samsung providing pre-order discounts.

technology.title: MacBook Neo 2 Reportedly Getting 12GB RAM and New Colors
technology.summary: The MacBook Neo 2 is expected to feature 12GB of RAM and an A19 Pro chip, with a release targeted for the first half of 2027. The device will also introduce new color options. As of now, there is no confirmed pricing. This upgrade addresses previous criticisms regarding RAM capacity in the earlier model.

sports.title: 'Where is Rajat Patidar?' - Former India batter questions selectors over Zimbabwe T20I squad
sports.summary: Former India batter Hanuma Vihari has questioned the selectors regarding Rajat Patidar's exclusion from India's T20I squad for the upcoming series against Zimbabwe. Vihari expressed his belief that Patidar deserved a spot on the team, highlighting his performance and contributions. The criticism reflects ongoing discussions about player selections and the criteria used by the team management.

sports.title: Captaincy weighed him down, freedom set him free: The remarkable second act of Joe Root
sports.summary: Joe Root concluded the ODI series against India unbeaten, amassing 249 runs across three innings, leading England to a 2-1 series victory. At 36 years old, he continues to perform at a high level, contrasting with many peers who have retired. Root's recent success marks a significant resurgence in his cricket career following his captaincy tenure.

sports.title: GAW vs SFU Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Guyana Amazon Warriors (GAW) will play against San Francisco Unicorns (SFU) in the second match of the Global Super League 2026. The match is scheduled for July 24, 2026, at 04:30 IST, taking place at Providence Stadium in Guyana. GAW enters the match as the defending champions, while SFU aims to secure a strong start in the tournament.

health.title: Health Experts Issue Summer Travel Food Safety Alert as Soaring Heat and Weak Cold Chains Increase Foodborne Illness Risks: New Travel Alert
health.summary: Health experts have issued a summer travel food safety alert, highlighting increased risks of foodborne illnesses due to extreme heatwaves, flight delays, and compromised hotel buffet lines. The warning emphasizes the importance of food safety during travel as soaring temperatures and disruptions in transportation can lead to unsafe food handling and storage conditions, raising health concerns for travelers.

health.title: Beyond the Fog
health.summary: Experts indicate that non-cognitive symptoms such as alterations in mood, sleep, smell, and movement may manifest years or even decades prior to a dementia diagnosis. While impaired memory and thinking are widely recognized as primary symptoms of dementia, these early indicators could provide crucial insights for early intervention and management of the condition, potentially improving patient outcomes.

health.title: Study Maps Motor Abnormalities Across Mental Health Spectrums
health.summary: A new study employed the Hierarchical Taxonomy of Psychopathology (HiToP) framework to investigate motor symptoms linked to mental health spectrums and psychosis risk. Analyzing data from nearly 3,500 participants without formal diagnoses, researchers assessed self-reported motor functions and psychological dimensions. The findings aim to enhance understanding of the relationship between motor abnormalities and mental health conditions.

science.title: Scientists Watch Chemistry Unfold Atom by Atom
science.summary: Scientists have developed a new method to observe electronic and vibrational dynamics in real time, allowing them to track molecular changes after light absorption. Within trillionths of a second, molecules can bend, shift electrons, and convert electronic energy into vibrations. This advancement enhances understanding of chemical processes at the atomic level, potentially impacting various scientific fields.

science.title: Integrated experimental and computational characterization of bioactive metabolites from Streptomyces paradoxus GH53 with antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antitumor activities
science.summary: Streptomyces paradoxus GH53 was identified and optimized for metabolite production. The crude extract was characterized using various spectroscopic methods, revealing a complex mixture. It exhibited antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antitumor activities, with specific IC₅₀ values for radical scavenging and cytotoxicity against cancer cell lines. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations suggested favorable interactions, though some metabolites showed potential drug-likeness limitations.

science.title: Sperm whales blow bubbles to achieve restful, vertical sleep
science.summary: Research from the University of St Andrews and Université de Neuchâtel reveals that sperm whales can sleep vertically just beneath the ocean surface. This unique sleeping position is facilitated by a mechanism involving bubble-blowing, allowing them to rest while remaining partially submerged. Sperm whales are the only known whales to adopt this distinctive vertical sleeping posture.
